The '''ur-diamond''',<ref name="GG" /> also known as the '''Nothoiin-system diamond''',<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> was a type of valuable [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on the [[Nothoiin's moon|crystalline moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]]<ref name="GG" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ur-diamonds were the principal export of the [[Nothoiin system/Legends|Nothoiin system]],<ref name="GG" /> and Nothoiin was famous for them.<ref name="TEA" /> The goods that the members of the [[Merchants Guild]] of the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of<ref name="GG2-2" /> the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Merchant/Legends|traded]] in included ur-diamonds.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ur-diamond was originally created by [[Christopher Kubasik]] as the "Nothoiin-system diamond" and introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> The diamond type was first identified as the ur-diamond in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" />
